shared_elements: horizontal band or belt-like line across the body/surface
justification: Both depict human forms and include a circular disc motif and horizontal banding, but these are near-universal elements: A is a monolithic three-dimensional figure with a schematic face and a few isolated symbols (a ring, a curved belt line) carved on a massive body, while B is a flat narrative relief panel showing a two-humped animal led in profile by an attendant with a staff, beneath a register band of repeated rosettes. The relationships differ entirely — B has a procession with a handler touching/leading an animal beneath an ornamental frieze, whereas A has no interaction between elements at all, only detached emblems distributed over a single body.
